book.name: Jon
book.title: JON Kamambuno Wakai Jon muno boglkwa

content: Yesus ya Nikodimas denbi dimbrika
Juda yagl kande ta moglkwa kangiye Nikodimas, ye Parisi ta moglkwa.

Ye enduwer undre, Yesus moglmara yegl dungwa, “Beke Notnga, no pirkan ounga ene ka beke notnga ta God di endungo unga, ene kimagl etnere yegl yomba ta erekraglkwa, ba God eremogl yomba ta mina mogl tenan ye pra kimagl etnere yegl erambuka.”
Yesus yegl di ikine endungwa, “Na ka kaima ene di teinga, yomba ta ye kor kugl yeikrimbi ukor pikran ye God kingdomo ta kankrambuka.”
Nikodimas aglkekor Yesus diprukwa, “Yomba yake kondungwa sraglmere mam aglkekor kugl yenambe? Kaima yene ye ende ikine mam dane suna kra enan mam aglkekor ta kugl yeikrambuka!”
Yesus ka mongo ditongwa, “Na ka kaima diteinga, yomba ta nigl ya Holi Spirit mina ta kugl yeikrambuka, ye God kingdomo mina suna ta pikrambuka.
Yomba nangino mina kugl yeingwa i yomba yoko, ba Holi Spirit kugl yongwa i spirit.
Na ka yegl dimara i ene sipuglo dikro, ‘Ene kaima aglke kordagl kugl yenaglkwa.’
Ir yene mange ta ena prumere ongwa, kugla dungo ene pirkwa, ba mange umara mo omara i ene ta kankrikwa. Yomba prapra Holi Spirit mina kugl yongwa i ir ormere kuno yegl.”
Nikodimas krapoglkwa, “Taragl i srambre ere plau dinambe?”
Yesus yegl di ikine endungwa, “Ene Israel yomba ka beke tenga yomba kande ta motnga, ba taragl i ene pirkitno?
Na ka kaima di ene teinga, no taragl punga pre dindre te taragl kamga i ditomga. Ba no ka dumga i ene kaima ta pir ina kiurikwa.
Makandle taragl na diteinga i ene ta pirngi dikrikwa, ana heven taragl i pre na dimbo ene sraglmere na pirngi dinaglme?
Ana yomba suwarata ende heven pikrikwa, ba Yomba Wam suwara ye heven mogltre ana ende atne ungwa.
Makan waule suna Moses eremogl toki ake mitna endungwa, kuno yeglmere Yomba Wam ake mitna endinaglkwa.
Yegl eran yomba prapra ye wedi pirngi dinaglkwa, ye kor aimande moraglkwa inaglkwa.
“God eremogl makan yomba prapra wakai-yene kangwa pre, ye Wam suwara kaima tongwa. Yomba ye wedi pirngi dinaglkwa ta goglkraglkwa, ba kor aimande moraglkwa inaglkwa.
God Wam di manginagle endungwa i yomba mambunono yumbu sinambuka pre ta manga, ba ye yomba ere-ina pre ungwa.
Yomba ta ye wedi pirngi dinambuka ye kot erekrambuka, ba ye wedi pirngi dikrambuka kot mina yange sungwa. Sraglpre God Wam suwara kaima kangiye mina ye wedi pirngi dikrikwa.
Ana kot eraglkwa mambuno i yegl, ambuglange ende makandle wu kondungwa, ba yomba ambuglange wakai kanamna payondi kondo mim wakai kanigwa, sraglpre ye mambuno kinde ere meglkwa.
Yomba prapra mambuno kinde erikwa, ye ken ambuglange kankinde yei, ana ye mambunono kinde wu pene pi dinambedi pre kundugl gogl ambuglange mina ukrikwa.
Ba yomba mambuno wakai kaima erikwa ye ken ambuglange mina ende suna wingwa, ana ambuglange i meglmara sinan, ye taragl erikura i ana God kamo dumere erikwa pre yomba kanaglkwa.”
Jon Baptais Yesus pre dipene endungwa
I mokomugl Yesus ya disaipelma wagle ende pi Judia dumo kande pindre enge tau ye bogl igle mogltre, ana yomba baptais ere teingwa.
Ainon dumo i Selim kamun magl, igle nigl suwarata wongwa ba niglmo mere moglkwa pre, Jon ama yomba ye moglmara baptais era pre wingo ye baptais ere tongwa.
(Enge i Jon kane singo paikrukwa enge.)
Juda yagl ta yongo te Jon disaipelmo tau yeingo nigl pai wu wakai eingwa mambuno i pre tengramo dingwa.

Ana Jon disaipelma tau ende wu Jon moglmara yegl dingwa, “Beke Notnga, yagl ta ene bogl akiye Jodan Nigle koglo imbo miurko ana ene ye pre kamo dingra, yaglmo i eremogl yomba baptais erete moglko ana yomba merkinde ende ye moglmara eingwa.”
Ana Jon yegl di ikine endungwa, “Neno kande heven moglkwa imbo taragl ta yomba tekran ana yomba ye yene ta ikrambuka.
Na ka i okuna kana dinga ene pirkondingwa, ‘Na Krais ta manga. Ba God eremogl ye pre singiye po diendungo na okuna kana winga.’
Ba yagl ta ambu inan ana ambu i ye embiye moglkwa. Yaglmo i yomba ta yeinongwa ye magl mogltre ka dungwa i pirtre ana pir gun yongwa yeglmere na ama gun pond yeinga i pra kuno orkwa.
Ye kangiye pai mitna endinan ana na kangina wu atne enambuka.

“Ana yomba ta kamun mitna ende atne ungwa i ye mogl-mitna ende taragl prapra engrukwa. Yomba ta makandle moglkwa i makan yomba, ana ka dinambuka i makandle yomba ka dimere yegl dinambuka. Ana yomba ta heven unambuka i mogl-mitna ende taragl prapra engrukwa.
Ye taragl kangwa ya te prukwa i kra dipene ende tongwa, ba yomba eremogl ye kamo i pir ikrikwa.
Ba yomba ta Yesus kamo pir inan ana embriye igle mina ye pirngi dungwa, i yegl, ‘God ka kaima dungwa.’
Te God di endungwa yomba ta ungwa i ye God kamo dungwa, sraglpre God eremogl Holi Spirit tongo yomba i mina mogl kau sungwa.
Nem eremogl yene Wam kanwakai yendre, ana taragl prapra i Wam ongo mina yongwa.

Yomba ta God Wam pre pirngi dimbi, ana kor aimande moraglkwa i inaglkwa. Ba yomba ta God Wam kamo ta pirngi dikrimbi ana kor aimande moraglkwa kankraglkwa. Sraglpre God dem kumbrukwa yomba i mina pangwa.”
